ProblemType as a StrEnum

PR playground for fix/3495-problemtype-strenum. Both shapes produce identical URI strings. They differ in what counts as a member of the registry.

    Verified against CPython 3.14. The f-strings evaluate correctly in both shapes, because
    enum members are not created until the class body has finished executing. The only
    behavioural difference is membership, which is what makes the registry trustworthy
    as a catalog.
